player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe {role} i roto i a Colonel Blotto.
Ko tō whāinga kia wikitoria ngā raupapa nui atu i tō hoa whawhai.
I ia raupapa, whakaritea {num_total_units} ngā wāhanga ki ngā papa {field_names}.
Ko te kaitākaro e whakarite ana i ngā wāhanga nui atu ki te papa e wikitoria ana i taua papa, ā, ko te kaitākaro e wikitoria ana i ngā papa nui atu e wikitoria ana i te raupapa.
He tauira, '[A7 B7 C6]' whakaritea 7 ngā wāhanga ki A, 7 ki B, ā, 6 ki C.
